description: Red de Estaciones GNSS de Castilla y León is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Junta de Castilla y León. The GNSS Network is a free and free public service of high precision positioning with GNSS receivers (Satellite Navigation Systems) within the territory of Castilla y León in ETRS89 datum. Coverage: Junta de Castilla y León. The portal shows the English title as "Network of GNSS Stations of Castile and Leon" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Junta de Castilla y León. Its keywords include Red GNSS, GPS, RTCM, RINEX, navegación por satélite, GLONASS. The listing shows 1 download or service links in OCTET-STREAM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es_ES). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
